name: self-produced-duo-both-performers
rule: A self-produced show with 1-2 named leads pursues EACH performer directly (#366), never the act. Each gets a second-person overrideBody naming the co-performer correctly (#634).

sources.label: Duo's own concert page
sources.content: Virgile Roche and Anna Pierre make their U.S. debut at Carnegie Hall on March 10, 2026. This recital is self-produced by the two pianists.

sources.content: Virgile Roche, pianist. Appearing with Anna Pierre at Carnegie Hall, March 10, 2026. Contact: virgile@virgileroche.example.

sources.content: Anna Pierre, pianist. Carnegie Hall recital with Virgile Roche, March 10, 2026. Contact: anna@annapierre.example.

contacts.name: Virgile Roche
contacts.overrideBody: My name is Dan and I'm a professional arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing in regard to your March 10 recital with Anna Pierre at Carnegie Hall. I work in an unobtrusive documentary style, no flash, so the audience doesn't notice me and nothing on stage is disturbed. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for nearly ten years, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't have someone on it already, I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the recital. I look forward to hearing from you.
